release_notes:
- Fixed critical Windows "Invalid serial port" regression where descriptive COM port labels (COM3 (USB-SERIAL CH340 (COM3))) returned by /api/ports were rejected by port validation
- Added canonical Windows COM port normalization across serial connections and all REST API endpoints while maintaining strict injection filtering
- Added community-verified Jura WE6 (EA) (EF532M V02.03, Article 15417) EEPROM beverage, maintenance & cockpit % calibration (spectra-captures#4)
- Prioritized article-number matching before base EF fallback so sibling EF532M models (15417 WE6 vs 15082 E60) never collide
